description: Las Vegas, NV – Cody K Whipple, Businessman, Rancher, and Republican candidate for Nevada’s 4th Congressional District, proudly announced today the endorsement of respected Nevada agricultural leader and businessman Bob Combs, founder of RC Farms in Las Vegas. Whipple is challenging career-politician and Democrat Congressman Steven Horsford. Combs, a fixture in Nevada’s farming community and known nationwide […]
